descriptionHtml:
Bug B19 · excluded (All tickets still in progress / ready for PR (not counted, Quinn 2026-10-14)) · was P1

Retention / purge is not implemented per UAT 3.6: 13-hour Important Points and 37-hour tasks, handoffs and vitals are still there; nothing is purged unless a device opens the app; past 500 patients some charts are skipped

Tickets: TFA-94699 in progress · counts as a QA bug: no (ticket in progress) · found on: local

Note: One root cause behind 19 cases; the windows themselves are decision D6

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S07 Short windows ±1 h (Hospital): pre-round and Important Points 11 h / 13 h, completed task 15 h / 17 h, encounter and note 17 h / 19 h

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U10 Records clear exactly at their window: each item is still present just before its window ends and gone just after it. (UAT OAT-04 Expected 1; TFA-94699 AC 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U2 Hospital pre-round text clears at 12 h: pre-round text seeded at 13 h is deleted. (UAT OAT-04 step 1; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: pre-round text 12 h)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U3 Hospital Important Points clear at 12 h: an Important Point seeded at 13 h is deleted. (UAT OAT-04 step 1; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: Important Points 12 h)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • T4 Hospital completed tasks are deleted 16 h after they were completed. (TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: completed tasks 16 h); UAT 3.6) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • T3 Hospital encounter dictation and note leave the working tabs at 18 h, are kept as yesterday's transcript / previous note until 36 h, and are then deleted. (TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: encounter, note); UAT 3.6) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Two synthetic Hospital patients aged by the aging helper: patient E at 11 h / 15 h / 17 h and patient L at 13 h / 17 h / 19 h, for pre-round text (since processed), an Important Point (since written), a completed task (since completed), and the day's encounter dictation and note (since recorded / generated)

When The purge runs; raw documents read with admin access

Then Patient E keeps every item. Patient L has no pre-round text, no Important Point and no completed task in the database; its encounter and note are off the working tabs and kept as yesterday's transcript and previous note

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.6 and the TFA-94699 table (12 h, 16 h, 18 h): present on the early side, absent on the late side (moved, not deleted, for the 19 h encounter and note) = pass; anything else = Fail. Tolerance around 'exactly' is Q1; the clock anchors are Q2 and Q3

Where it ran: local retention (clock moved to check retention); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: manual (blocked)

S07 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
